title: Stack External Tool Declarations
description: Declares external MCP tools whose instructions are injected into agent instruction files during scaffold. Follows the same common → stack → user merge pattern as mcp-servers.json.

name.description: Tool identifier (e.g. 'code-review-graph'). Used as the merge key.

package.description: PyPI/npm package name for install reference.

instructions.description: Markdown block injected into agent instruction files (CLAUDE.md, HERMES.md).

generate_mcp_json.description: When true, scaffold generates .mcp.json entry for this tool.
